mentions.name: Fillvisa Plus
mentions.description: This app is a paid version of Fillvisa aimed at immigration lawyers and law firms. It uses the same USCIS forms and field mapping as the free Fillvisa tool, and the revenue from it funds the free tier and gives an incentive to keep the forms maintained.
mentions.problem: USCIS revises forms regularly and without much warning, making keeping the forms up to date an ongoing maintenance commitment.
mentions.source_excerpt:
fillvisa.com is 100% free. That said, I'm also building a paid version (plus.fillvisa.com) for immigration lawyers/law firms. Both the apps utilize the same form + mapping.
Thus that cares of revenue + I have incentive to maintain the forms.
